spans.s: प्रण a. (f. णा) Old, ancient.
प्रण a. (f. णा) Old, ancient.

प्राण m. 1. Breath of life, vitality, principle of life (generally used in the pl.), प्राणैरुपक्रोशमलिमसैर्वा R.ii.53, or प्राणानामनिलेन वृत्तिरुचिता Sak.vii.; 2. the first of the five bodily airs; (they are प्राण, अपान, समान, व्यान and उदान), Bg.iv.29; (it resides in the heart); 3. wind, air; 4. digestion; 5. muscle, strength, power, गिरिचर इव नागः प्राणसारं बिभर्ति Sak.ii.; 6. the soul; 7. the supreme spirit; 8. an organ of sense, M.iv.143; 9. anything as dear as life; 10. the life of poetry, poetical talent, inspiration; 11. frank-incense.
प्रणख m. The point of a nail.
प्रणत a. (f. ता) 1. Bending, stooping; 2. bowing to; 3. humble; 4. skilful, (pp. of नम् with प्र q.v.).
प्रणत a. (f. ता) 1. Bending, stooping; 2. bowing to; 3. humble; 4. skilful, (pp. of नम् with प्र q.v.).
प्रणति f. 1. Obeisance, salutation, bow, प्रस्थानप्रणतिभिरंगुलीषु चकुर्मौलिस्रक्च्युतमकरंदरेणुगौरम् R.iv.88; 2. humility, courtesy, निर्जितेषु तरसा तरस्विनां शत्रुषु प्रणतिरेव कीर्तये R.xi.89.
प्रणदन n. Sounding, sound.
प्राण-दान n. saving one’s life.

प्रणय m. 1. Friendship, fond, regard, love, affection, Megh.ii.42, R.vi.12, K.S.v.35; 2. favour, kindness, एष ते प्रणयो विप्र शिरसा धार्यते मया Mrich.i.; 3. solicitation, request, begging, नार्हसि त्वं संबंधिनो मे प्रणयं विहंतुम् R.ii.28; 4. trust, confidence; 5. reverence, obeisance; 6. acquaintance, familiarity, Megh.i.27; 7. final beatitude.
प्रणाय्य a. (f. य्या) 1. Beloved, dear; 2. indifferent to worldly pursuits; 3. honest, upright; 4. disapproved, Bt.vi.66.
प्रणाय्य a. (f. य्या) 1. Beloved, dear; 2. indifferent to worldly pursuits; 3. honest, upright; 4. disapproved, Bt.vi.66.
प्राणाय्य a. (f. य्यी) Proper, suited.
प्रणय-अपराध m. an offence against friendship or love.
प्रणय-उन्मुख a. impatient through love.
प्रणय-कलह m. a lover’s quarrel, नाप्यन्यस्मात्प्रणयकलहाद्विप्रयोगोपपतिः Megh.ii. (considered to be an interpolation by Mall.
प्रणय-कुपित a. angry through love, Megh.ii.42.
प्रणय-कोप m. the feigned anger of a coquette towards her lover.
प्रणय-प्रकर्ष m. extraordinary attachment.
प्रणय-भंग m. 1. a breach of friendship; 2. faithlessness.
प्रणय-वचन n. a declaration of love.
प्रणय-विमुख a. disinclined to friendship, Megh.i.27.
प्रणय-विहति f. denial, refusal.
प्रणयन n. 1. Bringing, fetching; 2. executing, performing; 3. writing, composing; 4. decreeing, sentencing.
प्राण-अयन n. an organ of sense.
प्रणयिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Kind, affectionate; 2. beloved, dear; 3. desirous of, Megh.i.3, R.ix.55, xi.2; 4. familiar, intimate.
प्रणयिन् (II) m. 1. A friend, a favourite; 2. a husband, a lover; 3. a suitor, a petitioner, स्वार्थात्सतां गुरुतरा प्रणयिक्रियैव Vikr.iv.
प्रणयिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Kind, affectionate; 2. beloved, dear; 3. desirous of, Megh.i.3, R.ix.55, xi.2; 4. familiar, intimate.
प्रणयिनी f. 1. A mistress, a wife; 2. a female friend.
प्रणव m. 1. The sacred syllable om, प्रणवश्चंदसामिव R.i.11, K.S.ii.12, Bg.vii.8; 2. a kind of musical instrument; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्रणस a. (f. सा) Having a prominent nose.
प्रणस a. (f. सा) Having a prominent nose.
प्रणाश m. Loss, cessation, death, destruction, R.xiv.1.
प्रणाडी f. Intervention, interposition.
प्रणाद m. 1. A loud noise; 2. neighing, breying; 3. a murmur of rapture; 4. a cry for help; 5. a particular disease of the ear.
प्राण-आद a. fatal, causing death.
प्राण-द n. 1. water; 2. blood.
प्रणाम m. 1. Prostration, obeisance, salutation, K.S.vi.91; See under अष्टांगप्रणाम; 2. bending, stooping.
प्रणायक m. A leader, a chief.
प्रणाल m. 1. A channel, a drain, a water-course; 2. an uninterrupted series.
प्रणालिका f. 1. A channel, a drain, a water-course; 2. an uninterrupted series.
प्रणाली f. 1. A channel, a drain, a water-course; 2. an uninterrupted series.
प्रणाशन n. Destruction, annihilation, R.iii.60.
प्रणिंसित a. (f. ता) Kissed.
प्रणिंसित a. (f. ता) Kissed.
प्रणिधान n. 1. Effort, energy; 2. application, use; 3. renunciation of the fruit of actions; 4. respectful behaviour; 5. profound religious meditation, R.i.74, viii.19.
प्रणिधि m. 1. Solicitation, request; 2. care, attention; 3. a spy, an emissary, K.S.iii.6, R.xvii.48, M.vii.153; 4. a follower, an attendant.
प्रणिनाद m. A deep sound.
प्रणिपात m. 1. Falling at one’s feet, prostration; 2. reverence, obeisance, K.S.iii.61, R.iii.25.
प्रणिपात-रस m. a magical formula pronounced over weapons.

प्रणिहित a. (f. ता) 1. Outstretched, stretched forth, Megh.ii.43; 2. consigned, entrusted; 3. having the mind concentrated; 4. determined, decided; 5. obtained, attained; 6. spied out, (pp. of धा with प्र q.v.)

प्रणिहित a. (f. ता) 1. Outstretched, stretched forth, Megh.ii.43; 2. consigned, entrusted; 3. having the mind concentrated; 4. determined, decided; 5. obtained, attained; 6. spied out, (pp. of धा with प्र q.v.)
प्राणिन्-हिता f. a shoe, a boot.

प्रणीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Advanced, promoted; 2. presented, offered; 3. executed, accomplished, effected; 4. cooked, dressed; 5. taught; 6. composed, written; 7. sentenced, decreed, (pp. of नी with प्र q.v.)
प्रणीत (II) m. Fire consecrated by prayers.
प्रणीत (III) n. Condiment.

प्रणीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Advanced, promoted; 2. presented, offered; 3. executed, accomplished, effected; 4. cooked, dressed; 5. taught; 6. composed, written; 7. sentenced, decreed, (pp. of नी with प्र q.v.)
प्राणित a. (f. ता) Kept alive, animated.
प्राणित a. (f. ता) Kept alive, animated.
प्रणुत a. (f. ता) Praised, lauded.
प्रणुत a. (f. ता) Praised, lauded.
प्रणुत्त a. (f. त्ता) Driven away, repelled.
प्रणुत्त a. (f. त्ता) Driven away, repelled.
प्रणुन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Driven away; 2. set in motion; 3. shaking, trembling.
प्रणुन्न a. (f. न्ना) 1. Driven away; 2. set in motion; 3. shaking, trembling.
प्रणेतृ m. 1. A leader; 2. the promulgator of a doctrine; 3. an author.
प्रणेय a. (f. या) 1. Submissive, obedient; 2. to be accomplished; 3. to be settled.
प्रणेय a. (f. या) 1. Submissive, obedient; 2. to be accomplished; 3. to be settled.
प्रणोद m. Driving.
प्राण-अतिपात m. killing a living being.
प्राण-अत्यय m. loss of life.
प्राण-अधिक a. 1. dearer than life; 2. superior in strength.
प्राण-अधिनाथ m. a husband.
प्राण-अधिप m. the soul.
प्राण-अंत m. death.
प्राणंत m. Air, wind.
प्राण-अंतिक (I) a. 1. fatal, mortal; 2. lasting to the end of life.
प्राण-अंतिक (II) n. murder.
प्राण-आघात m. destruction of life.
प्राण-आचार्य m. a physician to a king.
प्राण-आबाध m. injury to life.
प्राण-आयाम m. suspending the breath during the mental recitation of the attributes of a deity.
प्राण-ईश, -ईश्वर m. a lover, a husband.
प्राण-ईशा, -ईश्वरी f. a wife, a mistress.
प्राण-ईश, -ईश्वर m. a lover, a husband.
प्राण-ईशा, -ईश्वरी f. a wife, a mistress.
प्राण-उत्क्रमण n. departure of the soul, death.
प्राण-उत्सर्ग m. departure of the soul, death.
प्राण-उपहार m. food.
प्राण-कृच्छ्र n. a danger to life.
प्राण-घातक a. destructive to life.
प्राण-घ्न a. life-destroying.
प्राण-च्छेद m. murder.
प्राण-त्याग m. 1. suicide; 2. death.
प्राण-दक्षिणा f. gift of life.
प्राण-दंड m. capital punishment.
प्राण-दयित m. a husband.
प्राण-द्रोह m. an attempt upon anybody’s life.
प्राण-धार m. a living being.
प्राण-धारण n. 1. maintenance of life; 2. vitality.
प्राण-नाथ m. 1. a lover, a husband; 2. an epithet of Yama.
प्राण-निग्रह m. checking the breath.
प्राण-पति m. 1. a lover, a husband; 2. the soul.
प्राण-परिग्रह m. life, existence.
प्राण-प्रयाण n. departure of life, death.
प्राण-प्रिय m. a lover, a husband.
प्राण-भक्ष a. feeding on air only.
प्राण-भास्वत् n. the ocean.
प्राण-भृत् m. a living being, अंतर्गतं प्राणभृतां हि वेद R.ii.43.
प्राण-मोक्षण n. 1. death; 2. suicide.
प्राण-यात्रा f. maintenance, subsistence.
प्राण-योनि f. the source of life.
प्राण-रंध्र n. 1. the mouth; 2. a nostril.
प्राण-रोध m. 1. suppressing the breath; 2. danger to life.
प्राण-वियोग m. death.
प्राण-व्यय m. sacrifice of life, M.M.i.
प्राण-संयम m. suspension of breath.
प्राण-संशय, -संदेह m. danger to life.
प्राण-संशय, -संदेह m. danger to life.
प्राण-संकट n. a very great peril.
प्राण-सद्मन् n. the body.
प्राण-सार a. vigorous, full of strength, all bone and muscle, Sak.ii.
प्राण-हर a. causing death, taking away life.
प्राण-हारक n. a kind of poison.
प्राणक m. 1. A living being; 2. myrrh.
प्राणथ m. 1. Air, wind; 2. a sacred bathing-place.
प्राणन (I) m. The throat.
प्राणन (II) n. 1. Breathing; 2. life, living.
प्राणंती f. 1. Hunger; 2. sneezing.
प्राणाय्य a. (f. य्यी) Proper, suited.
प्राणिन् m. 1. A living being, a living creature, Megh.i.5, Bg.xv.14; 2. a man.
प्राणिन्-अंग n. a limb of an animal.
प्राणिन्-जात n. a whole class of animals.
प्राणिन्-द्यूत n. gambling with fighting animals.
प्राणिन्-पीडा f. cruelty to animals.
प्राणिन्-हिंसा f. doing harm to living creatures.
प्राणीत्य n. Debt.
